name: testland/bogus-data
description: Authors .NET test fixtures using the Bogus library - fluent typed `Faker` builders with `.RuleFor` per property, generation via `Generate()` / `GenerateBetween(min, max)` / `GenerateLazy()`, and `UseSeed()` for reproducibility. Provides the Bogus equivalent of Python's Faker / Ruby's FactoryBot. Use when the project is C# / F# / VB.NET and the team needs typed fixture creation.
